segment.source: When the content comes from StackPanel, Grid or explicitly sized controls, GroupBox uses the content DesiredSize to calculate its total height.
segment.target: Quando o conteúdo comes de StackPanel, Grid ou explicitly sized controles, GroupBox usa o conteúdo DesiredSize para calculate its total altura.

segment.source: If the parent sets Height or MaxHeight, Avalonia layout constraints still decide clipping or scrolling.
segment.target: Se o pai define Altura ou MaxHeight, Avalonia layout constraints still decide clipping ou scrolling.

segment.source: The GroupBox below does not set Height, so its content area grows with the text rows.
segment.target: O GroupBox below does não definir Altura, so its conteúdo area grows com o texto linhas.

segment.source: GroupBox grows from the measured header, padding and content size when no height is set.
segment.target: GroupBox grows de o measured cabeçalho, padding e conteúdo tamanho quando não altura é definir.
